name: citation
purpose: An inline reference in generated text: a small rounded chip with the mark of the source's site (its favicon, its icon, or its first letter on a colour of its own) and the site's name (`Azion`, else the host of `href` without `www.`), and `+N` when one marker cites several sources (`[1][2]`, `[1, 2]`). Hovering, focusing or pressing the chip opens one card that stacks every cited source. `StreamingResponse` renders it for every run of `[n]` markers.
useWhen: A statement in a generated response that comes from one or more specific sources.
avoidWhen: A link the reader is meant to follow as part of the prose → a normal link.
related: `sources` — the pill and panel that list every source of the response.
bestPractices: Number in order of first use: [1], [2], [3]; the numbers stay in the accessible name.
Give each web source a `site` name (`Azion`, `GitHub`) and, when you have one, its favicon as `image`; a bare host reads as a URL.
Give each source its `publisher` and `publishedAt` when you have them.

props.name: indexes
props.doc: 1-based numbers of the sources this reference cites, in order: `[1]` gives `[1]`, `[1][3]` and `[1, 3]` give `[1, 3]`.

props.name: sources
props.doc: The sources of the response, in citation order; `indexes` point into it. A number with no source renders as a plain numbered note.
